verdict.rationale: Fly.io's docs describe strong technical support for spinning up many isolated, hardware-isolated VMs/Sprites that scale to tens of thousands and can be provisioned per-request or per-agent, which fits the story of enabling many simultaneous isolated environments. However, multiple independent hands-on reports directly contradict smooth, reliable simultaneous provisioning — e.g. 'pushing simple containers up would fail 70-80% of the time', 'random outages, builds not working', and 'deploys leading to stuck and unreachable instances' — undermining the claim that teams can reliably spin up unlimited environments to ship simultaneously. Missing for 10: reliable, undisputed evidence of scale in production, and confirmation the flakiness issues have been resolved.
